title: FLOCK HISTORY AUDIT REQUEST FOR GEORGIA NORTHERN JUDICIAL DISTRICT COUNTY SHERIFF’S DEPORTMENTS (Hart County Sheriff's Office)

communications.subject: Georgia Open Records Act Request: FLOCK HISTORY AUDIT REQUEST FOR GEORGIA NORTHERN JUDICIAL DISTRICT COUNTY SHERIFF’S DEPORTMENTS (Hart County Sheriff's Office)
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Georgia Open Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

To all relevant open record personnel: 

Public reports state that this county is using cameras from Flock Safety (a.k.a. "Flock"), the automatic license plate reader (ALPR) company. For the purposes of this request, when I refer to "Flock products," this includes hardware (Flock License Plate Readers (LPRs), Flock Safety Falcons, Flock Video Cameras, Flock Mobile Security Trailers, Flock Gunshot and Audio Detection Devices, Flock Drone as First Responder (DFRs), and Flock Alpha) as well as software (Flock Safety Platform, FlockOS, Flock911, Flock Nova, Flock FreeForm, Flock Vehicle Fingerprint technology, and the National LPR Network). Source:
https://www.flocksafety.com/products


Therefore, pursuant to Georgia Open Records Act, I hereby request the following records (dated September 19, 2026 to the time this request is processed):
1. All contracts, purchase orders, invoices, receipts, payment records, budgetary quotes, and related procurement records involving Flock Safety.

2. All training, instructional, presentation, and guidance materials concerning the use of any Flock Safety product or service, including hardware and software. This includes, but is not limited to:
a) Presentations, videos, audio recordings, scripts, manuals, and training materials;
b) Meeting notes discussing the use of Flock products;
c) Technical or operational explanations of how Flock products function; and
d) Internal or external documents used to explain, train on, or promote the use of Flock products.

3. All policies, procedures, agreements, and legal documents relating to Flock Safety or its products, including terms and conditions, privacy impact assessments, standard operating procedures, use policies, data retention policies, legal opinions, warranties, nondisclosure agreements, memoranda of understanding, liability waivers, insurance agreements, and any other formal or informal agreements.

4. All audit, oversight, or compliance records relating to Flock Safety or its products, including security audits, misuse investigations, and reports submitted to oversight bodies.

5. All records reflecting requests from other law enforcement agencies or private entities for data obtained through Flock products, including but not limited to requests for LPR data.

6. All communications and documents that reference
"Flock" / "Flock Safety," including emails, text messages, PDFs, word processing documents, spreadsheets, presentations, etc.

7. All communications with representatives of Flock Safety (email domain: @flocksafety.com) and any and all reports and data of your audits you have made as an agency yourself or have been subject to by any flock audits. 
Please try to include any other miscellaneous documents that facilitate this municipality's relationship with Flock that don't neatly fall neatly into the above categories.
I am a policy analyst for https://www.shirleyhuman.com/, so the requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes. Therefore, I request that any fees are waived. But in the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available. I also respectfully ask that my request is expedited, given the newsworthiness of Flock and its activities.

If you need to contact me, you can reach me at info@ShirleyHuman.com or 706-498-4275. Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 3 business days, as the statute requires.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 3 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Hanna Davison

communications.subject: RE: Georgia Open Records Act Request: FLOCK HISTORY AUDIT REQUEST FOR GEORGIA NORTHERN JUDICIAL DISTRICT COUNTY SHERIFF’S DEPORTMENTS (Hart County Sheriff's Office)
communications.communication:
The “record’s requested” subject line would not let me fill in the entirety of my request. See below for full request details; 

To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Georgia Open Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

To all relevant open record personnel:

Public reports state that this county is using cameras from Flock Safety (a.k.a. "Flock"), the automatic license plate reader (ALPR) company. For the purposes of this request, when I refer to "Flock products," this includes hardware (Flock License Plate Readers (LPRs), Flock Safety Falcons, Flock Video Cameras, Flock Mobile Security Trailers, Flock Gunshot and Audio Detection Devices, Flock Drone as First Responder (DFRs), and Flock Alpha) as well as software (Flock Safety Platform, FlockOS, Flock911, Flock Nova, Flock FreeForm, Flock Vehicle Fingerprint technology, and the National LPR Network). Source:
https://www.flocksafety.com/products

Therefore, pursuant to Georgia Open Records Act, I hereby request the following records (dated September 19, 2026 to the time this request is processed):
1. All contracts, purchase orders, invoices, receipts, payment records, budgetary quotes, and related procurement records involving Flock Safety.

2. All training, instructional, presentation, and guidance materials concerning the use of any Flock Safety product or service, including hardware and software. This includes, but is not limited to:
a) Presentations, videos, audio recordings, scripts, manuals, and training materials;
b) Meeting notes discussing the use of Flock products;
c) Technical or operational explanations of how Flock products function; and
d) Internal or external documents used to explain, train on, or promote the use of Flock products.

3. All policies, procedures, agreements, and legal documents relating to Flock Safety or its products, including terms and conditions, privacy impact assessments, standard operating procedures, use policies, data retention policies, legal opinions, warranties, nondisclosure agreements, memoranda of understanding, liability waivers, insurance agreements, and any other formal or informal agreements.

4. All audit, oversight, or compliance records relating to Flock Safety or its products, including security audits, misuse investigations, and reports submitted to oversight bodies.

5. All records reflecting requests from other law enforcement agencies or private entities for data obtained through Flock products, including but not limited to requests for LPR data.

6. All communications and documents that reference
"Flock" / "Flock Safety," including emails, text messages, PDFs, word processing documents, spreadsheets, presentations, etc.

7. All communications with representatives of Flock Safety (email domain: @flocksafety.com) and any and all reports and data of your audits you have made as an agency yourself or have been subject to by any flock audits.
Please try to include any other miscellaneous documents that facilitate this municipality's relationship with Flock that don't neatly fall neatly into the above categories.
I am a policy analyst for https://www.shirleyhuman.com/, so the requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes. Therefore, I request that any fees are waived. But in the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available. I also respectfully ask that my request is expedited, given the newsworthiness of Flock and its activities.

If you need to contact me, you can reach me at info@ShirleyHuman.com or 706-498-4275. Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 3 business days, as the statute requires.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 3 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Hanna Davison

communications.subject: Illinois Freedom of Information Act. Request: Community ALPR Audit (Peoria Heights Police Department)
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Illinois Freedom of Information Act., I hereby request the following records:

I hereby request the following records: 1. Justification Records All records used to justify adoption of Flock Safety cameras, including but not limited to: staff reports, city council or county board memoranda, crime analysis reports, presentations, vendor proposals, and any other documents that described the purpose, anticipated benefit, or stated rationale for purchasing or leasing the system. 
2. Effectiveness and Use Statistics All statistical reports, internal summaries, use-justification documents, crime-reduction assessments, or after-action reviews evaluating the effectiveness of Flock Safety cameras since installation. This includes any records prepared in connection with contract renewals. 
3. Cost and Financial Records All financial records related to Flock Safety cameras, including invoices, purchase orders, annual subscription payments, installation costs, and maintenance costs from the date of first installation through the present. Include any records showing federal, state, grant, or civil asset forfeiture funding used to offset costs. 
4. Camera Inventory and Placement The current inventory or deployment list of Flock Safety cameras operated by or accessible to this agency, including number of units and general location descriptions. Also include any written policies, criteria, risk assessments, or internal documents used to determine camera placement locations. 
5. Contracts and Legal Agreements Copies of all active and recently expired contracts, amendments, renewals, data-sharing agreements, memoranda of understanding, and scope-of-work documents between this agency and Flock Safety. 
6. Data Access and Network Sharing (a) The Flock "Organization Audit" report showing all searches made within this agency's Flock system from the date of installation through the date of this request. (b) The Flock "Network Audit" report showing all searches of this agency's Flock data by any outside agency from the date of installation through the date of this request. (c) A list of all agencies currently authorized to access this agency's Flock data, including any federal agencies. Please provide these records in their original electronic, machine-readable format (CSV or spreadsheet). 
7. Security Incidents and Unauthorized Access All records documenting any security incidents, unauthorized access, data breaches, hacking events, or unauthorized sharing of data collected by Flock Safety cameras, including any correspondence with or notifications from Flock Safety related to such incidents. 
8. Secretary of State Audit All records, correspondence, or internal communications related to the Illinois Secretary of State's 2025 audit of ALPR data-sharing practices, including any communications with the Secretary of State's office or Flock Safety regarding compliance. 
9. Marketing and Sales Materials All promotional, descriptive, and marketing materials shared with this agency by Flock Safety or any representative thereof prior to or in connection with the purchase or renewal of the Flock Safety system. 
10. Communications with Flock Safety Emails to/from Flock Safety personnel addresses; sales@flocksafety.com, support@flocksafety.com, or any email addresses in the format firstname.lastname@flocksafety.com from January 1, 2022 through the date this request is processed. If this date range is too burdensome due to the amount of emails, then I'd like it narrowed down to January 1, 2022 through December 31, 2022 & January 1, 2025 to the date this request is processed. 
The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes. In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 5 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Trever Flahaut

communications.subject: New York Freedom of Information Law Request: Sheriff Detention (Sheriff's office)
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the New York Freedom of Information Law, I hereby request the following records:

- The most recent contract, including any amendments and modifications, between your office and U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) and/ or the U.S. Marshals for the purpose of allowing ICE to utilize bed space in your jail.
- Records relating annual inspection of the facility conducted in 2023, 2024, and 2025 by the U.S. Department Homeland Security. These records should include the full annual inspection report and any documents or communications regarding the inspection.
- Records relating any other local, state, or federal inspections of the facility conducted in 2023, 2024, and 2025.
- Any ICE Enforcement and Removal Operations Facility Significant Incident Summary (SIS) produced between January 1, 2023, and the date this request is processed.

Since January 1, 2023:
- Communications, including electronic communications and attached documents, between your department and ICE and/or the U.S. Marshals related to the contract. This should include any communications and documents relating to requests, approvals, or denials of waivers of contract provisions.
- Billings, invoices, and records of payment made pursuant to the contract.
- Monthly records on the average daily population and average length of detention of people detained in ICE custody at the jail.
- Complaints or grievances filed by people detained in ICE custody at the jail.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 5 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Julia Rock

title: California Public Records Act Request — Flock Safety ALPR Audit Logs

communications.subject: California Public Records Act Request: California Public Records Act Request — Flock Safety ALPR Audit Logs
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the California Public Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

To Whom It May Concern:

Under the California Public Records Act (Gov. Code § 7920.000 et seq.), I request copies of the audit logs, search logs, and usage reports associated with the Monterey Park Police Department's operation of Flock Safety Automated License Plate Reader (ALPR) systems.

The records I seek were generated between September 5, 2025 and September 5, 2026, and consist of the following:

1. Organization Audit Logs (Search Logs) — a record of every license plate and vehicle-characteristic query run by department personnel in the Flock platform, including:

the date and time of each search;
the identity of the user who ran it (user ID, badge number, or name);
the query terms entered (plate numbers or vehicle descriptors);
any case number, reason, or justification recorded alongside the search.

2. Network Sharing Records — a current export or listing of the department's network share configuration, identifying both the outside agencies that receive Flock data from your department and the outside agencies whose data your department can access.


These records originate in a database and exist natively as structured data. I therefore ask that they be produced in that native electronic form — .CSV, .XLSX, or an equivalent spreadsheet file — consistent with Gov. Code § 7922.570(a). Please do not flatten the spreadsheets into PDFs.

To be clear, this request does not cover ALPR photographs, plate images, or investigative case files. It is limited to the administrative audit and usage records showing how department personnel have used the software.

If fees apply to the search or duplication of these records, please notify me before the total exceeds $20. I also request a waiver of all fees, as release of this information serves the public interest.

Should you conclude that any portion of the requested material is exempt, please issue a written response identifying the specific statutory exemption claimed, redact only the exempt portions, and release the balance of the records.

Thank you for your time and assistance.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 calendar days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

LARECS

communications.subject: Pennsylvania Right to Know Act Request: Ghost vehicle crash report
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Pennsylvania Right to Know Act, I hereby request the following records:

1. Any correspondence, presentation materials, or press materials the Salisbury Township Police Department prepared or provided to Government Fleet magazine (or its author, Clayton Wong) in connection with the article "'Ghost' Cars Lower Crash Rates," published September 21, 2017. https://www.government-fleet.com/articles/ghost-cars-lower-crash-rates
2. Any internal report, memo, or document from 2016 that discusses or contains crash-rate data for the township's "main eastside roadways," including but not limited to any document referencing a 30% reduction in crash rates following deployment of the department's reflective/"ghost" livery patrol vehicle(s).
3. Any underlying crash data, crash counts, or crash statistics — for the years 2012 through 2016 — for the roadway(s) referenced in item 1 above, including whatever geographic area or road segment(s) the department defined as the "main eastside roadways."

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 5 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Matthew Petti
